Best deals in car washes & rental trucks.

A group of seven of us just rented road bikes for five days of riding through wine country from Isla Vista.   They were not top of the line, but worked very well for over 220 miles. The service was extremely friendly and helpful.  The price was 1/3 of any other bike shop in the area.   You will like this bike shop!

I really enjoyed myself on their patio today, sipping a delicious hand crafted cocktail that included strawberry and fresh basil as the edible garnish. My friend had another Prosecco-based cocktail with elderflower liquor. Both were not too sweet, had lovely herbaceous undertones, and citrusy overtones. Pure Heaven. Then we had our late lunch. I had a Panzanella salad, which has slightly roasted tomato, fresh mozzarella, almond pesto, and focaccia croutons. This "peared" (haha!) nicely with my pear, Gorgonzola, caramelized onion flatbread pizza stuffed with candied walnuts. To die for. She enjoyed her perfectly crispy salmon fillet nestled atop an anchovy dressed Caesar salad. There was so much more on the menu I can't wait to try: eggplant parmigiana, tuna, lasagna, a burger with truffle fries. And a breakfast cafe will be opening in the front part of the building in two weeks, according to our server. It will be on the Broadway side of the beautifully landscaped patio area we sat outside today, which opens at 11:30 I believe she said. Do yourself a favor and try this place out for a relaxing retreat and to recharge your soup with friendly servers, green grass and palm trees, and poodles who smile from their chairs (yes it's dog friendly).

My wife went into the Emergency Room at Jefferson Hospital on Tuesday evening.  She was in a room separated from a busy hall by a curtain.  She was told she would get a room upstairs when it became available.  (By Thursday evening, it had not become available.)   By Thursday night, the noise in  the hall was so loud that it became intolerable.  Her medical tests were carried out when someone or a facility was available.  

The quality of the medical care seemed fine, although slow.  Nurse service wasn't always available when needed.  (There was no nurse's call button in the room.) 

In our view, the patient facilities in  the ER were uncomfortable, i.e., incoming patients on gurneys were left in the hallway surrounded by EMTs, blocking the passage.

I cannot speak highly enough about DogTown's Daycare and staff. We have used this location multiple times to board our pups, Luna (siberian husky) and Elsie (border collie mix), when we go on vacation. Even though we live 1 hour away, we still always choose to make the drive rather than find a new daycare. Not only is it very affordable ($35/night for each dog INCLUDING daycare), but the staff is very accommodating and friendly, and the facility is PERFECT and has plenty of space for our dogs to romp around. The facility included multiple large indoor fields w/ turf grass, which is great for inclement weather. When we first got Elsie as a puppy, she was timid with other dogs, but the DogTown staff took the time to slowly introduce her to the other dogs at daycare, and now she is so outgoing and comfortable with all dogs. It has done WONDERS for her socialization. The only downfall for DogTown would be that they don't have live cameras to watch our pups play while we are away, but we typically call every day during their stay, and someone is always happy to update us on the pups. Of course, when we pick them up they are EXHAUSTED, and you can tell that they have had a fun few days and gotten plenty of exercise. I would highly recommend DogTown for your doggie daycare needs! They are fabulous and affordable, and of course, the dogs LOVE it there!

Hands down the BEST Mexican in town.  Please go NO WHERE else. Enchiladas Guadalajara is seriously the best ever. Horchata and the hibiscus tea is so delicious. That Salsa bar is to die for.... seriously. Keep in mind that they are ALWAYS busy (due to being the best) so be prepared to wait in a longer line and trying to find a seat.  Definitely worth the wait!!
Katie is a fantastic stylists and l like how they allow you to make appointments and the owner is very nice as is everyone that works there. Most importantly you will get a good haircut.

A lot of my friends recommended this place and I haven't been here since high school so I went for lunch today with my mom and grandma. The sushi didn't taste fresh and it was so mushy we couldn't even pick it up. The best thing about this place was their cold beer other than that I don't think I'll be back.

What a wonderful, LOCAL florist!  Bouquets and arrangements are available in all sizes, at any level of extravagance, for any occasion.  All arrangements are prepared on-site and are made to order.  Delivery locally is always an option, as is walking in of course.  In fact, if choosing delivery, you can add some wonderful cupcakes from "Mini's Cupcakes" at a discounted rate.  Had relatives from back in NY order flowers for my wife's baby shower, along with cupcakes.  Delivery was on time and everything was as expected and fresh as can be.  Any time I need flowers (and cupcakes!), I'll be calling Posh!

If you are thinking about trying OTF, do it!  Luckily, if you are reading this review you are considering Northwest Reno for your home studio, the staff is awesome.  
Orangetheory Reno is more than just a gym, it's a community of dedicated individuals achieving their own goals in a group setting.  The workouts are predetermined and the coach will take you through everything.  Scheduling workouts is easier than ordering an Uber and they are always on time.  Another great aspect of OTF, is that it is suitable for everyone; grandpas, millennials, former Marines, housewives, dentists, whomever...the workouts can be accommodated for any skill level or one can push themselves to their own hard.  All you have to do is walk in the door.

First, let me start by saying I have never felt the need to review anything online and here I am. This was my first time trying Shyan's and the gentleman who is the owner is one of the most humble and kind men I have ever met. He picked my meal for me and must have thanked me 7 times for coming and said he hoped i would return. Mind you this was all for a to go order. I had the chicken kabobs, boneless lamb curry and Naan. Everything was really amazing, i will definitely be returning.

Had the raw oysters, chargrilled oysters (a little diff from acme- it was more buttery here, with the cheese more cooked/charred so the texture was slightly different - not better or worse) crawfish etouffe, fried crawfish pies (imagine crawfish dumpling hot pocket), onion rings, and a side of cole slaw so we could get in our veggies, with their local Nola beer! Finally, we had the warm pecan pie! Delicious! Would absolutely recommend!

I had never ate at the Sky Blue Cafe under the old ownership but the new owner has this place rocking. The food was excellent both breakfast and lunch options. I had a chicken Parmesan sandwich which was a special that day and hopefully becomes a standard menu option. My mom had a classic breakfast of eggs, toast, bacon and home fries all of which she said was excellent. The Drews Brew Coffee was tasty and prices were reasonable. Most important of all the new owner and the staff are super nice Wish they were open more often but when they are you should go!

Went with a group of six And we had a blast! Our server Whitney was great, she did a wonderful job handling our rowdy crew. We literally got everything on the menu...literally everything. I love southern food and their menu didn't disappoint. Shrimp and grits topped the list of must eat items and all the drinks were delightful as well.

Now i love a good, classic burger joint, and usually Johnny rockets can fit the bill. BUT I went there on a Saturday night, and while i was seated within minutes, it took almost an hour to get our burgers. So frustrating, and then, my wife's patty melt was not to order.  Terrible experience overall--felt disjointed, the music was way too loud (louder than usual).  I'd rather go to Ruby's Diner

Traveling from Nevada to Portland, chose this place based on good reviews. They deserve it. Reasonably priced considering full breakfast and amenities. Rooms were clean, exceptionally comfortable, and had everything we needed, including iron and board. Huge bathroom with separate toilet room, good quality toiletries dispensed in an environmentally friendly way. Staff friendly, helpful , and courteous. We are experienced travelers, with high expectations--this place exceeded them.

There should be no shame in seeking to produce a high-quality cup of coffee, to elevate beyond your average cup of Joe and the Starbucks mediocrity. Still, if the effort of doing so becomes so over-produced, if each cup requires more than 10 minutes for full fruition, have we not just moved from one form of disappointment to another? Barista Parlor's location is enviable, and its layout is interesting. Unsuspecting visitors should however be aware of the generous servings of pretension that come with each visit: this place screams hipster. As with many other places of its type, this hipster label is mobilized to  excuse service that in any other place would be seen as below-par. To focus again on the ridiculous timeline involved in getting a coffee, the longer the wait the more 'exclusive' or 'artisanal' the coffee, the associations of which seem more important to the staff (and to some part of the clientele) than the coffee itself. To go further, there is no menu of product, the line is long and slow-moving, there is a certain attitude that pervades and turns off those not 'of the scene' and the coffee - when it finally arrives - while crafted and cared for, will not hit the spot for those looking for a simple espresso. So, do visit this place if you want to study ethnographically the hipster culture (or if you are already part of it). If not, caveat emptor...

There is only one word to describe our experience with Tile Alliance, exceptional! Jason is honest, straightforward and completely dependable. The crews were friendly and professional and the workmanship excellent. Our bathroom tile project was completed on time, under budget with results beyond expectations. Tile Alliance will always be our go to company for any future tile projects.

They really worked with us to remedy a sales error.  We unknowingly signed on for a "lay of the land/rolling" fence when we really wanted (& thought we ordered) a straight line fence.  Jason & his assistant were saints in working with us on the actual installation.  Karen also was very accommodating.   We are very happy with the outcome.  
The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is due to the initial error pertaining to the straight line style we wanted.  After that was settled, we couldn't be happier.  
I would highly recommend this co.!

I moved here from another state. 
So moving means needing to find all new doctors and places to go for medical needs and checkups. I found Envision through both yelp reviews and through my company's insurance plan with UHC. 
I really like this place. The overall location is a little tricky to find the first time because you can easily turn into a parking lot nearby and not the street you need to drive to the end of. Anyway, they have nice decoration and great staff and assistants.
Dr. Barry is very knowledgeable, friendly, and informative. He will tell you everything you need to know and more, whether you want to hear it or not. Haha he will lift you up in every way possible too, making sure you know how great and special you are (and your eyes). 

I also really love and appreciate Liz. She was honest, patient and helpful when we picked out new frames, deciding which shape and style best fit my face.

I bought a years supply worth of contacts which came along with a free pair of sunglasses of my choosing. They ended up being polarized, so they are great!
Many Healthy options available. Food is always fresh and delicious.  The staff there is super friendly and helpful.

I've been to Oxford Exchange and the decor is so nice!
They have a little store near their restaurant and the restaurant has outdoor and indoor seating.
I love coming to this place when ppl come here from out of town visits.
It's super classy 
I've been here for breakfast and it was good.
We had their pancakes and it was really good.
I would deff come back here for a nice spot to eat.

We live downtown and like to walk to non-chain restaurants for dinner. My wife and I went to Mesh on a Tuesday night, early (6:00-ish), while the main dining room was almost empty. The young ladies acting as hosts asked us if we had reservations, to which I replied "At 6:00 on a Tuesday?" The hostess replied that they could seat us in the bar. We reluctantly agreed, and dined there. Our service was good, and my crab cakes were excellent. I had the lobster bisque before the crab cakes, and the bisque was as good as anyplace else -- nothing particularly special but nevertheless good. My wife had a vegetarian dish with lots of butternut squash in it and she really enjoyed it.

We had been seated at one of those bar tables that is high with tall stool-like seats, so when we left both of us were a bit sore from being uncomfortable during dinner. Also as we left we took a look at the main dining room and there was a 2-top table wide open, a couple of 4-tops open, and perhaps more in the back we could not see. We were dressed appropriately (we're both professionals who had come from work) so the hostess declining to seat us in the main dining room was an irritation that will probably keep us from going back. 

If you're young and "hip" and the hostesses like you, this might be a good dining spot for you.
Good place to get tire fixed cheap 10 bucks they do not plug it they dismount the tire and patch from the inside was in the area.

Saw this restaurant on the food network and had to try it when we visitied. We were definitely not let down. The actual hot dogs were a good size and the buns were incredible. Also they were well priced.
First time here and salad and diablo steak pasta are amazing! Salad completely fresh and very good price for what it is!. Excellent customer service!

This place is garbage. Delivery drivers have no idea where they're going, and the pizza is almost always cold or the wrong order. Staff are extremely unapologetic about messing up. Maybe because they mess up so frequently? I literally made this account just to write this review, because we've had so many bad experiences with this place. Save your time and money and order pizza elsewhere.

This place sucks !!!! The workers are so rude! My order is wrong every single time & then when I go back to get what I actually ordered they cop a nasty attitude. The cookies they leave out on the counter are always over 5 days old. I've gotten egg bacon cheese bagels but give up bc second time I've gotten raw white runny eggs. So disappointed when you spend $7 on a bagel sandwich. This place is horrible !!!!! I recommend you not visit this location.

If you are on the fence about getting support from Varsity Tutors, I highly recommend you use them!  Before the recent school closures, my daughter was struggling with her Honors Algebra class. With the now very limited support from her teacher, we were concerned she would not not be prepared for Algebra II in the Fall. Varsity matched her with an instructor who is not only covering her current math content but who is also teaching her skills she didn't fully master at the beginning of the year.  We were so happy with the Algebra tutor, she added a Sign Language instructor to help her build a new skill with her extra time!

In town for the Big 10 Championship game. 
The food and the service were both fantastic. We would definitely eat here again. I highly recommend the ribs.

I read about this restaurant in Philadelphia Magazine. I think someone who lives in the Wynnewood area but works and lives part-time in NYC noted that Sang Kee rivaled any Asian restaurant in NYC, so we had to give it a try.

We ordered carry out which was fast and easy. Except we had a difficult time finding the restaurant's official menu, and we found a few on various sites, but they were slightly different from each other.

When I went to pick up the food it was packaged and ready. It was a Saturday night around 6:15, and the place was packed which was a good sign!

We ordered the following:
1) large wonton soup: ok, the menu said shrimp and pork, and that's what it was. The shrimp were whole pieces of small shrimp which I've never had in wonton soup. It was a little too shrimpy for me, and the noodles were overcooked, but the overcooked noodles could very well have been due to the carryout. The broth for the soup was really very good!

2) pan friend dumplings: these were crispy and very delicious. I don't know what the sauce was, but that was very tasty too! I think these dumplings were the best part of the meal. Get these!

3) chicken pad thai: boring! Lots of noodles and some green peppers with a very small amount of nuts sprinkled on top. I've had lots of better pad thais. It was tastier with some soy sauce and salt, but still lacked interest. I wouldn't order this. 

4) vegetable chow fun: I LOVED the noodles! This entree was pretty good. The snow peas, carrots, and water chestnuts were crispy, and I loved the addition of the mushrooms!! The sauce was good, but I think I'd get this spicy next time. I had to add soy sauce and salt for a little more flavor, but this one is a keeper!

Overall, I enjoyed this, and I'd definitely go back to try some other options and eat in the dining room just to see if those wonton noodles tighten up a little bit :P

This review is for Sat May 5th. Our server Paige was an absolute delight. She made excellent recommendations and made us feel at home. The food was delish! I recommend the $43 Special for Two: 1 app, 2 entrees, 2 entrees to go and a dessert. We had leftovers from our main entrees plus the to go entrees...we had food for 4 days at home! Maggianos decorated our table to make it special and they did the same for the Prom Group too. Paige heard about our delay from our 'Anniversary' that she provide a plate of fresh lemon cookies too. We will be back and hope to have Paige one again!

This place opened up in Godfrey within the past month. We went for lunch. The service was a little slow, which I'm sure they are working out the kinks. The gyros were heaping full of meat and feta, mine could have used a little more sauce. The fries were fresh from the fryer, we had to blow on them to cool them down. We will go back to try the hot dogs and baked potatoes.

I have nothing but the best things to say!  Moving to Philadelphia, it was difficult to find a new haircutter.  I tried a couple places, but found the best match for me at Hair on the Square.  Nicole consistently does an excellent job, and most importantly my fiancee loves my haircut.

Simply amazing it is 1130 at night and we're just not eating here get a drink and it is incredible the hamburger is absolutely to die for better than anything that I've tried for music and then on top of that they have live music playing in on Thursday night amazing

I love this cinema.  Before the movie starts, the projectionist comes in and says if there are any problems, or if it gets too hot or cold, that you can go to the concession stand and let them know.  I love going to see what we call the artsy-fartsy movies.  Many of these are independent films that are not shown at regular theaters.  They also sell the same treats that the other cinemas offer with a large variety of flavored popcorn.

See you at the movies.

Great sandwich and soup combo. We had a party of 4 and all of us enjoyed our meal.  Portion size was decent for lunch. Service was fast and the owner sat down and took the time to give us recommendations for our evening out.  Great little place to stop for a quick bite to eat.
First time trying out The Brunchery! Great food, great locally Roasted coffee, and off the charts services. We had a nice visit with Stanley, the owner, and plan to be back soon!

If your hours on your website are till 12am and you come in at 10:30pm you don't tell your guests you stop serving dinners. Just inform people on your website that after a certain hour you can only get appetizers and salads.
Enjoyed a fresh veggie hoagie from Pickles & Chips today! Wonderful friendly service. Vegetables used in all their products are grown locally without pesticides from Highland Orchards.

Sushi is one of those foods where everyone thinks they're an expert.  And if you say you've found a great sushi place, people automatically disregard it because they've already found the world's best sushi someplace else.  This place is good.  Very good.  Is it the best?  Maybe to some people.  Is it the worst?  Not unlesss you're lying to yourself and everyone else.  They have creative specials and the new atmosphere is one of the trendier you'll find in Tampa Bay.  Most importantly everything seems fresh.  The prices are on the high side, so don't go here looking for value.  Go with an open mind, forget all of their questionable awards, and just enjoy it for what it is: A good sushi restaurant with a fun atmosphere.

The location was the only positive thing about our recent stay at this hotel.  The rooms are very old and were missing basic items; tv remote, coffee filter, soap.  Our stay was for 3 nights and we never received maid service.  We had to get our own supplies off the maid cart.  We were willing to accept the hotel for what it was since we booked it for $89 a night (you get what you pay for).  Then, while checking out on a Saturday morning, was told the rate for weekend nights changed to $170.  We were not made aware of this by the resort or booking.com.  Very disappointed.  This hotel was not worth $170 a night and considering the service and condition of the room, $89 was pushing it.

Owner is very friendly & took the time to explain everything cuz I'm so not a car person. Tint was done in less than an hour for the two front windows & strip on my accord coupe. Prices are very fair, clean shop & will defiantly recommend & return if needed!!!!

Two of stopped in for dinner, curious since we've never been here before but pass by frequently.  I ordered steak, and my wife ordered shrimp.  Steak was so-so, nothing to brag about, but my wife's shrimp was the absolute worst in presentation, flavor and quality.  Needless to say, we won't return nor recommend this restaurant.

I had my nails done here about a year ago, and I thought that it was a good, cheap, casual place to get my nails done. They also had cute color choices. Since I almost never get my nails done, I didn't come back until a few days ago. They completely remodeled, including new comfty chairs and a receptionist. I really liked the new look, and it felt big and spacious. The pedicure chairs also looked really comfortable, although I didn't get to try them out. 

It was late afternoon/early evening on Friday, and they had plenty of staff ready to go when I walked in the door. They sat me down right away to start my manicure ($14). My manicurist was very nice and friendly, although quiet (I did have a little bit of trouble understanding her because she had an accent and was wearing a face mask and talking quietly, so maybe she just thought I was deaf). She did a great job cleaning up my nails and giving me the exact look I was hoping for with the shape of my nails. The process of the manicure was fairly similar to most nail places- the one awesome part was when they put lotion on your hands, they place your hands in electric hand warmers and massage your shoulders for a few minutes. Very relaxing!

Overall, the remodel has made the place a lot nicer, and I think the prices are a tiny bit higher than they used to me. In addition to manis and pedis, they also do waxing (and maybe also facials, but I'm not positive). I walked in with no problem, but I also heard the receptionist taking appointments at the front desk. Most of the people getting their nails done seemed to be regulars. I'll definitely be back for a quick- and fairly cheap- mani/pedi in the future!

Best produce stand I've ever seen and such a variety! Veggies, meats, and fruit freshest of the fresh. They even have a variety of olive oils, fresh cheese, eggs and seafood. Everything you need, Steve's got it. They mix specialty meats daily. Fresh herbs and spices galore. This produce stand is worth stopping by!

I've dined at a few Mellow Mushroom's in the past but this one was the ultimate Bomb! My wife and I were staying in Franklin for a doctor's appointment and decided to order in for dinner.  Noticed that this Mellow Mushroom was fairly close to the hotel.  Browsed the menu and placed an order for me and her because she has celiac sprue and is gluten intolerant separate orders were the way to go!  The food arrived fairly quickly and piping hot!  My pizza was delicious and loaded with toppings and the crust was not too thick and not too thin but just chewy on the inside and crispy on the edges.  Cheese was gooey and all the way to the edge.  My wife's gluten free crust was as usual thin and crispy.  Overall this food was better than my previous experiences with Mellow and not to say the others were bad but this was exceptional!
Had a great time watching the game here. Service was great and the food was yummy  if you're sitting outside you can ask for them to turn the TV right by the large windows!!

I loved exploring all the great little eateries and delis that are housed in this market.  There is such a nice variety of different places including ice creameries, bakeries, BBQ/soul food places, Chinese, sandwiches, Thai, oyster bar, coffee, Amish stands, etc.  It reminds me of the Ferry Building in San Francisco, but with a more comfort food, blue collar vibe.

While we were there we sampled things from Dutch Eating Place (Amish), Bassetts Ice Cream, Dienner's BBQ, Tommy Dinic's, some Chinese place, Flying Monkey Patisserie, and an Amish vendor that sold fresh squeezed juice.  Everything was generous, freshly made, well serviced, clean and fairly pried.  

A definite must see when in Philly.  Hours are Mon-Sat 8-6, Sun 10-5.
Great beer selection. The bartenders are also really understanding & don't rush you to pick something
